title: VISO: Robust Underwater Visual-Inertial-Sonar SLAM with Photometric Rendering for Dense 3D Reconstruction
authors: Shu Pan; Simon Archieri; Ahmet Cinar; Jonatan Scharff Willners; Ignacio Carlucho; Yvan Petillot
reasons: authoritative arXiv metadata verifies title, authors, identifier, and submission date

summary_en: Presents an underwater SLAM system combining stereo cameras, an IMU, and 3D sonar, with coarse-to-fine online camera-sonar extrinsic calibration and photometric rendering that transfers visual appearance onto sonar-derived dense geometry.
